bullets.text: First Look at Metro 2039 - **Xbox** showcases the upcoming title, promising a thrilling single-player experience this winter.
Cryptographic Inventory Strategy - **Microsoft** emphasizes the need for a comprehensive cryptographic inventory for quantum readiness.
Sapphire Sleet Cyber Campaign - **Microsoft** reveals a North Korean cyber threat targeting macOS users through social engineering.
Ultimate College Bundle - **Microsoft** offers students exclusive deals on Windows 11 PCs, enhancing productivity and gaming.
AI Incident Response Challenges - **Microsoft** discusses the evolving landscape of incident response in the age of AI.
PostgreSQL on Azure - **Microsoft** launches resources to enhance PostgreSQL app development and migration.
Smart Tier for Azure Storage - **Microsoft** announces general availability of smart tier, optimizing storage costs automatically.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - **Microsoft** rolls out new Insider Preview builds, enhancing user experience and security.
